{{Location disambiguation|{{PAGENAME}}|outpost=Zaishen Elite (outpost)}} {{Otheruses|the mission|the quest|Zaishen Elite (quest)}} {{Mission infobox | name = Zaishen Elite | campaign = Core | region = The Battle Isles | type = Challenge | partysize = 4 | preceded by = [[The Path of the Zaishen Elite]] }} The [[Zaishen Elite]] [[challenge mission]] is a [[Player versus Player|PvP]] training simulation, in which a team of 4 players is pitted against an opposing team of computer-controlled opponents. The opponents are the same as in the [[Zaishen Challenge]], with the exception of the [[Smiting Monks]] team that is removed from the pool. Unlike [[Zaishen Challenge]], opposing teams and arenas are selected at random each round. The opposing teams also increase in numbers every 3 consecutive wins, up to a maximum of 12 opponents. ==Mission information== ===Requirements=== *You must win 5 games against different types of teams in [[Zaishen Challenge]] to unlock access to Zaishen Elite on the account. **Characters under [[level]] 20 can participate in this activity. ===Objectives=== *[[Annihilation]] ===Reward=== {{pvp reward | link-faction = y | unique = 40 | victory = 50 | flawless = 50 | consec = 50 }} You can earn up to 6,000 Balthazar faction per day from the Zaishen Elite. Faction earned in other simulated PvP (i.e. [[Training Arena]] or Zaishen Challenge) will be deducted from the early rounds. Faction earned in non-simulated PvP does not count against this limit. The faction cap resets every 24 hours from when you last started any of the simulated PvP. Like other Arena battles, the game must last at least 30 seconds to grant victory and flawless victory points to the winning team. ===Arenas=== File:Amnoon Arena map.jpg | [[Amnoon Arena]] File:D'Alessio Arena map.png | [[D'Alessio Arena]] File:Fort Koga map.png | [[Fort Koga]] File:Heroes' Crypt map.jpg | [[Heroes' Crypt]] File:Shiverpeak Arena map.jpg | [[Shiverpeak Arena]] ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Human]]s *{{w}}{{r}} 20 [["I Will Avenge You" Warriors]] *{{E}} 20 [[Obsidian Spike Elementalists]] *{{Me}} 20 [[Illusionary Weaponry Team]] *{{R}} 20 [["Victory Is Mine" Trappers]] *{{W}}{{R}}{{Me}}{{N}} 20 [[Degeneration Team]] ==Notes== {{Anomaly|All of the enemies have only one visible [[profession]], but use skills from two.}} {{Bug| *You can't [[resign]] if a Zaishen Fighter henchman is in your party. *On some maps, most notably D'Alessio Arena, an NPC of the opposing team will occasionally spawn outside of their team's gate and will rush your team early. }} *It is possible to detect the [[Illusionary Weaponry Team]] prior to the beginning by looking at the [[Score Chart]]. They temporarily lose health due to [[Illusion of Weakness]], which is visible in the health chart. *The opposing team rushes at your spawn so you can easily beat this mission by taking one or two [[trapper]]s in your [[party]]. *Faction cap raises as you progress: 2,000 (from rounds 1 through 4), 4,000 (from rounds 5 through 7), and 6,000 (from round 8 and forward). *The following table shows faction gained through flawless consecutive victories:
